errors.evidence: The description states that the categories on the horizontal axis are arranged in alphabetical order. This is incorrect. The categories are "Ценова стратегия на база разходи", "Ценова стратегия на база цени на конкуренти", and "Ценова стратегия на база ценност на продукта за клиента". The distinguishing words are "разходи" (starts with 'р'), "цени" (starts with 'ц'), and "ценност" (starts with 'ц'). In the Bulgarian alphabet, 'р' comes before 'ц', so the order shown is not alphabetical.

The description fails to mention that the bars are arranged in descending order according to their values (49.3%, 31.5%, 19.2%). The prompt specifically asks to describe if the bars are sorted in any particular way.
